WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as baseline_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(eventannotm, 'Missing') as timing_group,
    AVG(instownpct) as group_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(eventannotm, 'Missing')
),
with_excess AS (
  SELECT
    ga.group_avg,
    ga.group_avg - b.baseline_avg as excess
  FROM group_averages ga
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE ga.group_avg > b.baseline_avg
)
SELECT
  AVG(group_avg) as mean_of_group_averages,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM with_excess;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in eventannotm form a single 'Missing' group rather than being excluded from grouping
